title: 5 Merch Setup Jobs The AI Does For You
desc: The DIGITVL Stores AI handles the boring setup jobs for your merch store. You approve every price.

sentences.text: Merch setup is five boring jobs. Let the AI do them.
Here they are, one by one.
One, picking products that actually exist in the catalog.
Two, matching your colors to real garment colors.
Three, filling in your brand details from a chat.
Four, suggesting prices above a safe floor.
Five, putting everything in a draft for you to review.
You do one thing. Say yes. Start at stores.digitvl.com
